about: Per-league bars, statistics only (no bookmaker prices). Built by scripts/build_bars_statistics.py from the commits named in each proposal's `source`. Rebuild after a new proposal or approval.

stake_plan.rule: Real stakes on 2026-11-21 ONLY on the 3 PROMISING cells, small (0.5% of bank, flat per cell). Every other cell and every other TOP-3 tip is PAPER (shown and recorded, stake 0).
stake_plan.source: owner decision 2026-11-16 ("3 proven cells only"); stakes recorded in config/bankroll_policy.json cell_staking on prep/bars-oddsapi-hist

overrides.text: Finland NF Over 3.5 at 0.5%: owner override 2026-11-15 "Lift for Finland only" (the New-Format Over 3.5 track stays blocked for every other league).

Argentina NF BTTS at 0.5%: owner 2026-11-15 "Reduce to 0.5%" (UNPROVEN on real bet-time prices, kept small as a league rule). The 2026-11-16 decision names only the 3 PROMISING cells for real stakes, so whether Argentina stakes real money or paper from 2026-11-21 is confirmed with the 2026-11-20 approval.

not_adopted.title: Per-league calibration variants (P10): tested, not adopted
not_adopted.text: The same protocol v5 bars study on two calibration variants of the clean team models (A = league level + logit calibration, B = logit calibration alone). Neither creates a PROVEN cell in any league, the same as the clean champion (0); every combined-Holm p is 1.0. Both variants drop La Liga 2 O2.5 (a staked cell) to UNPROVEN. The report recommends keeping (b) as the basis; the variant-A proposal TP-2026-11-16-9cef8a02 is filed as evidence only and is not approved.

counts.variant: A: league level + logit calibration, TP-2026-11-16-9cef8a02
B: logit calibration alone (research, no proposal filed)

evidence_note: Study ROI / CI: the selection study on own bet-time prices (matchday block bootstrap, 95%). Fresh-holdout verdicts are labelled "re-test after a price-data fix (outcomes previously seen)" - never untouched proof. CLV = mean closing-line value of the study bets.
